title: Successful user login with valid credentials
description: Ensure that a user with valid email and password can log in successfully and establish a secure session.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid email and password credentials.
Click the login button.
Verify that login is successful, user is redirected to dashboard, and secure session is established.

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify system behavior when a user enters incorrect email or password and attempts to log in.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid email or password.
Click the login button.
Confirm login fails and an appropriate error message is displayed without exposing sensitive information.

title: Role-based access control enforcement
description: Validate that users with different roles have access only to authorized routes and features according to their permissions.

steps.description: Login as a user with a specific role (e.g., admin, warehouse staff, customer).
Attempt to access pages and features outside of assigned role permissions.
Verify access is granted only to allowed resources and forbidden for unauthorized areas.

title: Dashboard displays real-time shipment status and KPIs
description: Check that the main dashboard loads shipment statuses, transit statistics, revenue metrics, and operational analytics with real-time updates refreshed every 30 seconds.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the dashboard page.
Verify the initial display of shipment statuses, KPIs, revenue metrics, and charts.
Wait for at least 30 seconds to observe real-time data refreshes.
Confirm data updates are reflected without duplication or delay and UI updates smoothly.

title: Shipment lifecycle CRUD operations
description: Validate complete shipment management including creation, reading, updating, and deletion with proper input validation and immediate UI update upon changes.

steps.description: Navigate to shipment management page.
Create a new shipment with valid data.
Verify shipment is created successfully and visible in the shipment list.
Edit shipment details with valid updates.
Confirm changes are correctly saved and reflected in the UI.
Delete a shipment from the list.
Verify the shipment is removed and the UI updates instantly.

title: Real-time AWB shipment tracking with timeline visualization
description: Ensure users can enter an AWB or tracking ID and view accurate, real-time shipment status, location history, and timeline visualization reflecting current data within expected update intervals.

steps.description: Navigate to the shipment tracking page.
Input a valid AWB/tracking ID.
Check that shipment status, location history, and timeline visualize all relevant events accurately.
Wait and verify real-time updates propagate without duplication or lag.

title: Barcode scanning with GS1 validation
description: Test warehouse barcode scanning system to validate barcodes according to GS1 standards and correctly associate scanned cargo with shipment and inventory data.

steps.description: Navigate to the barcode scanning page.
Scan a valid GS1 barcode.
Verify validation passes and scanned cargo is correctly linked in inventory and shipment records.
Scan an invalid or malformed barcode.
Confirm the system detects invalid barcode, rejects it, and displays a relevant error message.

title: Invoice generation and PDF export
description: Check invoice creation for shipments, ensuring accurate data population and the ability to export invoices as correctly formatted PDFs.

steps.description: Navigate to the invoice management page.
Generate an invoice for an existing shipment.
Verify the invoice contains correct shipment and billing details.
Export the invoice to PDF format.
Check that the exported PDF matches displayed invoice data and has proper formatting.

title: Customer and manifest management functionality
description: Validate CRUD operations on customer data and creation and management of cargo manifests, including bulk shipment processing.

steps.description: Navigate to the customer management page.
Add, edit, and delete customer records with valid data.
Confirm operations succeed and UI updates accordingly.
Navigate to the manifest management page.
Create and update cargo manifests with multiple shipments.
Verify manifests are saved, searchable, and associated with correct shipments.

title: Inventory tracking with shipment integration
description: Test warehouse inventory tracking features integrated with shipment data and barcode scanning ensuring synchronization and stock accuracy.

steps.description: Access the inventory tracking page.
Update inventory items manually and via barcode scanning.
Verify inventory levels are updated correctly and reflect any linked shipment movements.

title: Exception handling for shipment delays and damages
description: Ensure exceptions such as shipment delays, damages, and other issues can be logged, managed, and displayed correctly in the exception handling module.

steps.description: Navigate to the exception handling page.
Create exception records for delays and damages for specific shipments.
Verify exceptions are stored accurately and reflected in related shipment statuses.
Update and resolve exceptions.
Confirm exception resolution updates shipment lifecycle and UI reflect changes promptly.

title: Payment processing and transaction monitoring
description: Validate the tracking and management of payment transactions related to shipments, ensuring accuracy and secure handling.

steps.description: Access the payment processing page.
Enter and record payment transactions linked to shipments.
Verify transactions are logged correctly and financial data is accurate.

title: Session management and secure cookie handling
description: Ensure sessions are securely managed with Supabase, including secure cookies, expiration handling, and prevention of unauthorized reuse.

steps.description: Login and verify secure cookie attributes (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite).
Simulate session expiration and confirm user is logged out and redirected appropriately.
Attempt session reuse or cookie tampering.
Verify session invalidation and protection against unauthorized access.

title: Input validation using Zod schemas on client and server
description: Test form inputs across shipment, customer, and invoice forms with valid and invalid data to verify proper schema validation and error handling both client- and server-side.

steps.description: Open shipment creation/edit form and submit with missing required fields.
Check client-side validation errors are shown; server rejects invalid submissions.
Submit forms with invalid data types or malicious input (e.g., script tags).
Ensure all inputs are sanitized; errors returned without server exceptions.
Submit forms with correct and valid data.
Verify form submits successfully and persists data.

title: UI theme toggle functionality and accessibility compliance
description: Verify that toggling between dark and light themes affects all UI components consistently, uses semantic OKLCH color tokens, and preserves accessibility standards including ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation.

steps.description: Load the application and toggle between dark and light modes.
Confirm UI colors change appropriately using design tokens and that no hardcoded colors are present.
Verify all interactive elements have proper ARIA attributes and keyboard navigability is preserved.

title: Global error boundaries and Sentry integration
description: Test that runtime errors in UI components are caught by error boundaries and reported to Sentry for monitoring without crashing the entire application.

steps.description: Trigger a runtime error in a controlled component (e.g., throw exception inside a component).
Ensure the error boundary displays fallback UI and error details are sent to Sentry.

title: API response structure and error status handling
description: Verify API endpoints respond with consistent standardized data structures, appropriate HTTP status codes, and error messages for success and failure scenarios.

steps.description: Call API endpoints with valid requests.
Verify responses have correct HTTP 2xx status and expected data format.
Call API endpoints with invalid or malformed requests.
Confirm responses have appropriate error HTTP statuses (4xx, 5xx) and error message bodies.

title: Performance testing on page load times and bundle sizes
description: Measure and ensure all pages load within 2 seconds under normal network conditions and bundle sizes are optimized below set thresholds via lazy loading and code splitting.

steps.description: Load key application pages including landing, dashboard, shipment management, and tracking.
Verify page load times are less than 2 seconds under typical network conditions.
Analyze route bundle sizes using built-in tools or profiling utilities.
Ensure bundle sizes conform to limits to prevent performance degradation.

title: Navigation and layout responsiveness across devices
description: Verify sidebar, header, navigation components, and layout adapt responsively to various device sizes and support theme toggling with no UI breakage.

steps.description: Access application on desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport sizes.
Confirm navigation components render correctly, are usable on each viewport, and maintain accessibility.
Toggle dark and light themes on each device size.
Verify layout and navigation remain consistent and visually coherent.

title: Server Actions process mutations with cache revalidation
description: Test that all user data mutations invoke server-side actions that validate input, perform database updates, and trigger frontend cache revalidation to reflect changes in the UI instantly.

steps.description: Perform a data mutation such as creating or updating a shipment.
Verify server validates inputs, updates database, and frontend cache is invalidated causing UI to refresh with new data.
